# reselling_storage_classes (Data Source)

Storage classes volumes can be created in on a cluster, with size limits and the monthly price per GB.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_storage_classes" "fra" {
  cluster_id = data.reselling_locations.fra.locations[0].clusters[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `storage_classes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_classes))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_classes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_classes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `is_ssd` (Boolean)
- `max_size_gb` (Number)
- `min_size_gb` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `price_per_gb_monthly` (Number)
- `step_gb` (Number)
